title: Bajo La Luz
style: Orchestral pop with tropical nocturnal sway, gentle Latin percussion, symphonic folk colors, and a live choir of froggish male vocals; sparse intimate verse, hush-and-breath pre-chorus, then a communal Spanish chorus that opens wide with strings, flutes, congas, acoustic guitar, upright bass, and warm poolside field ambience. Close-mic lead duet, natural ribbits and croaks as backing texture, layered group harmonies, glowing and punchy mix., soft, musical, acoustic, tropical, bright, breaks, vocal, warm, folk, distinct, soul, beautiful, rich, joyful, emotional, pop, orchestral, mellow, soulful, polyphonic, light, low, latin, magical, playful, gentle, natural, deep, heartfelt, dynamics
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Daylight hush]
We wait by the palms
quiet as glass
humans still wakeful
so we hold our breath

A small green throat
a tiny bright peep
then night leans in
and the pool starts to sleep

[Verse 1]
[M]
I stayed on the leaf edge
watching the yard go still
blue cups on the table
moon on the little hill

[F]
I heard you from the drainpipe
soft as a hidden bell
said, brother, come closer
the water knows us well

[M]
We live in the corners
where the warm dark grows
with old brick steps
and the mangos low

[F]
And every small ripple
says we are home
when the world turns quiet
we are not alone

[Pre-Chorus]
[M]
Bajo, bajo
hear us rise

[F]
Cerca del agua
open your eyes

[M]
One more peep
one more glow

[F]
Wait for the circle
watch us grow

[Chorus]
Bajo la luz
bajo la luz
cantamos aquí
bajo la luz

Bajo la luz
bajo la luz
poolside corazón
bajo la luz

Pee-pee, ribbit
croak and bloom
all night long
under the moon

Bajo la luz
bajo la luz
familia de noche
bajo la luz

[Verse 2]
[M]
Then came the tree frogs
bright in the lime green
hopping through hibiscus
like they own the scene

[F]
Then the old toads answered
deep from the stone
one by one we gathered
making the dark our home

[M]
The ocean kept breathing
far past the wall
and every soft wave
made the smallest frogs call

[F]
A splash on the water
a shake in the reed
we learned how to love
what the night gives need

[Pre-Chorus]
[M]
Bajo, bajo
hear us rise

[F]
Cerca del agua
open your eyes

[M]
More and more voices
more and more light

[F]
Nicaragua night
holds us tight

[Chorus]
Bajo la luz
bajo la luz
cantamos aquí
bajo la luz

Bajo la luz
bajo la luz
poolside corazón
bajo la luz

Pee-pee, ribbit
croak and bloom
all night long
under the moon

Bajo la luz
bajo la luz
familia de noche
bajo la luz

[Bridge]
[M]
Quiet all day
for the sleeping town

[F]
But when the moon comes
we wear our sound

[M]
Tree frog, toad, bullfrog
small and tall

[F]
Different skins
one song for all

[Final Chorus]
Bajo la luz
bajo la luz
cantamos aquí
bajo la luz

Bajo la luz
bajo la luz
poolside corazón
bajo la luz

Pee-pee, ribbit
croak and bloom
all night long
under the moon

Bajo la luz
bajo la luz
familia de noche
bajo la luz

[Outro]
We fold back quiet
with dawn in sight
but tonight was ours
and it felt so right

Pee-pee, croak
one last swell
under the light
we knew ourselves
